class.name: HEGoStrataTargets
class.brief_description: Publishes the heightfields an HEGo node's HDA outputs into procedural terrain layers.
class.description: Add it as a child of an [HEGoNode3D] and list the layers in [member targets]. A cook then becomes one transaction: every terrain input is snapshotted before upload, every target receives a complete validated result, and anything that changes or fails along the way leaves all previous results, terrain and Outputs alike, in place. Paths in [member targets] are relative to the HEGo node, the same as its input paths.

method.name: of
method.description: The binding under [param host], or null when it has none.

method.name: ensure
method.description: The binding under [param host], created when it has none. A new binding is owned by the host's owner, so it is saved with the scene; add the host to its scene first.

method.name: mark_stale
method.description: Records that the host's inputs or parameters changed, so every bound layer and any runtime bake built from them is stale until the next explicit cook.

method.name: skips_output_handler
method.description: One terrain backend per cook: a host publishing into terrain layers does not also let another output handler turn the same heightfields into terrain.

members.member: Complete procedural output bindings. Each entry has path, channels, and optional required_channels. Height is required by default when declared; use mask-only declarations for scalar-only stages. Targets must be explicitly procedural.
Stable identity of this producer, recorded on the layers it publishes. Generated on first use when empty.

constants.constant: Key this extension keeps its per-cook state under in the shared cook dictionary.
Name given to a binding created with [method ensure].
